subject: Re: POC scope re-baseline / added use case (Acme Corp)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Jared Olsen <jared@acme.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@acme.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>

Subject: POC next steps & success criteria (recap)

Hi Jared / Priya —

Thanks again for the call today — good to align on priorities. Quick recap and next steps so we have a shared baseline for the PoC: 

Scope (agreed):
- Primary use case: real-time customer support assistant for tier-1 tickets (short answers, routing suggestions)
- Secondary: embeddings for search/reranking over internal KB (pilot set: 10k docs)

Success criteria (what success looks like to Acme):
1) Avg. 95th percentile latency < 400ms for chat path under 50 rps test
2) Intent classification accuracy >= 88% on the evaluation set (provided by Acme)
3) Elastic search reranking improves click-through rate (CTR) in test harness by +10% (baseline provided)
4) No PII leakage in logs; all request logs validated via masking rules

Timeline:
- Kickoff (data access + infra) by Mon, Feb 16
- Baseline tests & initial integration by Feb 23
- Joint evaluation window Feb 24–Mar 5

Owners:
- Redwood: Marissa (exec sponsor / sales), Rishi (SE lead), Camila (integration)
- Acme: Jared (product owner), Priya (engineering lead)

Attachments: initial PoC scope doc and checklist attached.

Next steps:
1) Priya — share sample KB export + evaluation labels by EOD Feb 15
2) Rishi & Camila — prepare staging endpoints and test harness access by Feb 16
3) Marissa — finalize SOW and send a short MoM after this thread

Let me know if anything above is incorrect or missing. Happy to jump on a quick call tomorrow.

Thanks,
Marissa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0186
From: Priya Singh <priya.singh@acme.com>

Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 09:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC next steps & success criteria (recap)

Thanks Marissa — this looks good and clear. One request from our side: during today's call a product stakeholder asked whether we can add a small extractive summarization use case for support agents (summarize last 3 messages in a thread). It's lower priority than the chat flow but would be valuable to evaluate alongside the main POC.

If we add summarization, we would like:
- A qualitative check (agent-rated helpfulness) and a quantitative proxy (ROUGE-L against our hand summaries)
- Target: average ROUGE-L >= 0.45 across 100 validation threads

Can Redwood scope that in without pushing the timeline out? If we need to re-baseline, we can accommodate as long as we land the new plan this week.

Jared and I can provide a sample of 150 annotated threads by Mon (Feb 16).

—Priya
Lead, Platform Engineering, Acme Corp
priya.singh@acme.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: POC next steps & success criteria (recap)

Great request — thanks Priya. Short answer: yes, we can add extractive summarization as a tertiary use case, but it will require a small re-baseline to include the summarization evaluation and tune the model selection. Proposed re-baseline (quick):

Updated scope:
- Tertiary use case: extractive summarization (last 3 messages) with evaluation on 100–150 annotated threads

Updated success criteria (addition):
- Summarization average ROUGE-L >= 0.45 across the validation set (100 threads)

Updated timeline (minor push):
- Kickoff/data + sample artifacts by Mon, Feb 16 (unchanged)
- Integration & initial configuration by Feb 24 (moved +1 day)
- Joint evaluation window Feb 25–Mar 8

Impact: adds 4 business days to the joint evaluation window; SE time estimate: +8–12 engineer-hours for feature extraction and evaluation scripts. May require temporary increase in staging capacity during evaluation runs (Rishi can confirm).

If that works for you, I'll update the scope doc and SOW and share for signatures. We can treat the summarization run as a parallel evaluation that doesn't block the main chat/embeddings deliverables.

Attaching a redlined scope (acme_poc_scope_v2.pdf) and our updated checklist.

Marissa
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>

Subject: Internal: Acme POC — feasibility and capacity check (need quick reply)

Team — Priya at Acme would like to add a summarization use case (extractive, last 3 messages). Proposed minimal impact re-baseline (see thread): +4 days on evaluation window, +8–12 SE hrs, may need a bump in staging capacity for the run.

Can you confirm:
1) SE effort realistic? (Rishi)
2) Any infra work or routing changes required? (Marcus)
3) Risks to the existing chat/embeddings tests?

We need to respond to Acme by EOD today to lock the updated timeline.

Thanks,
Marissa
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Internal: Acme POC — feasibility and capacity check (need quick reply)

Marissa —

Confirmed. SE estimate of 10 engineer-hours to wire up the summarization extraction and evaluation harness (we'll reuse the embeddings pipeline). Infrastructure: small temporary scaling for the staging cluster during the eval run (increase from 2 to 3 nodes for 48 hours) — Marcus please confirm cost/ops impact, but should be straightforward. No risk to the primary chat path if we keep the summarization runs scheduled off-peak and isolated in a parallel route.

I recommend we include a simple fallback: if latency budget is exceeded during a combined stress test, we deprioritize summarization runs (non-blocking).

Rishi

Hi Priya / Jared —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for sharing the sample threads. We've reviewed internally and can commit to the added extractive summarization evaluation with the following agreed re-baseline: 

Finalized updates:
- Scope: add extractive summarization (last 3 messages) as tertiary use case
- Success criteria addition: summarization ROUGE-L >= 0.45 on 100 threads
- Timeline: joint evaluation window Feb 25–Mar 8 (4-day extension)
- SE effort: ~10 hours (Rishi)
- Infra: temporary staging bump (2 -> 3 nodes for 48 hrs) 
- Risk mitigation: summarization run is parallelized and non-blocking; fallback policy to pause summarization if latency SLOs are at risk

Attachments: acme_poc_scope_v2.pdf (redlines) and redwood_poc_checklist.xlsx.

Please confirm you accept these updates and we will issue a short amendment to the SOW and schedule a 30-min sync on Mon (Feb 23) to review integration details.

Thanks,
